interpretation: The paper's '~ 2' figure description is the typical (RMS-scale) envelope of the *multiple-scales* reconstruction at the slow stable focus: RMS|z_MS| = 1.83, very close to the paper's eyeball '~ 2'.  The MS reconstruction peak is 3.08.  The full numerical integration yields a peak of 2.84, falling between the MS RMS (1.83) and the MS peak (3.08).  Read at the same scale as Fig 5 (a fast-time waveform whose central body is at +/- 2), the visual '~ 2' corresponds to the MS solution's typical amplitude rather than its absolute peak.  This resolves the apparent 2 vs 2.84 gap.
